source_documents.title: Saccharin-derived multifunctional emitters featuring concurrently room temperature phosphorescence, thermally activated delayed fluorescence and aggregation-induced enhanced emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: the strong positive solvatochromic effect of the three lumi­ nogens was observed.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6-Cz-Sac, 5-Cz-Sac and DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvents n-hexane, toluene, DCM, THF and DMF; spectra discussed with Fig.S14.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors interpret positive solvatochromism across all three emitters as ICT between carbazole and saccharin. DiCz-Sac alone is explicitly quantified as shifting from 445 to 529 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI spectra were not inspected. The 445-to-529 nm shift is not assigned to 5-Cz-Sac or 6-Cz-Sac; no time-resolved charge-transfer kinetics is established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 348 ms for 6-Cz-Sac, 664 ms for 5-Cz-Sac, and 285 ms for DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.subject: DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystals synthesized from commercial carbazole, ambient conditions after 365 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: DiCz-Sac has a reported RTP lifetime of 285 ms and steady-state blue emission peak of 470 nm. Its phosphorescence is dominated by yellow emission around 570 nm with a weak blue component around 470 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Lifetime data are main-text reports of Fig.S16, not inspected SI. Fig.2 on p.5 was visually inspected. These are commercial-feedstock crystal values, not intrinsic purity-independent molecular constants.

reference_evidence_units.quote: All the crystals of Cz-Sac-Lab compounds exhibited phosphorescence emissions under ambient condition with the lifetimes determined to be around 2.5 ms
reference_evidence_units.subject: Cz-Sac-Lab purity controls including DiCz-Sac-Lab
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Control syntheses using lab-made carbazole from diphenylamine; Cz-Sac-Lab crystals.
reference_evidence_units.statement: All three lab-carbazole controls retain ambient phosphorescence but have only approximately 2.5 ms lifetimes, far shorter than commercial-carbazole samples.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Approximate series value; do not assign an exact fitted value to any one lab sample. Lifetimes are reported from Fig.S18, which was not inspected; main Fig.2 contrasts lab/commercial spectra.

reference_evidence_units.quote: may be caused by the trace amount of the carbazole isomer
reference_evidence_units.subject: Commercial-carbazole Cz-Sacs and lab-made controls
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation of the lab-made versus commercial carbazole control.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors provisionally attribute the dramatically extended commercial-feedstock RTP lifetimes to a trace carbazole isomer, while describing millisecond RTP as intrinsic to the lab-made derivatives.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The impurity identity, amount and operative energy/charge-transfer pathway are not demonstrated by this main-text passage. Do not replace 'may' with confirmed causality or infer a host-guest mechanism.

reference_evidence_units.subject: DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single-crystal diffraction and packing analysis, Fig.3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: DiCz-Sac has intermolecular C-H...pi and C-H...O contacts assembling a 3D network. Fig.3A shows two donor-acceptor torsions of 54 and 62 degrees; Fig.3C-D depicts its packing.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.3 visually inspected. The pi-stacking discussion specifically distinguishes the two mono-carbazole compounds; no equivalent effective DiCz-Sac pi stack is asserted.

reference_evidence_units.quote: considered as an efficient pathway to prevent energy loss and stabilize the triplet excitons.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three Cz-Sac crystals including DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of Cz-Sac crystal interactions, continuing p.5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose compact packing/intermolecular interactions as a triplet-stabilizing contributor and relate packing differences to different RTP lifetimes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This packing interpretation coexists with the purity-control caveat; it does not override evidence that trace isomers may dominate lifetime extension.

reference_evidence_units.subject: DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water titration, Figure 5 panels E/F; inset UV excitation 365 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: DiCz-Sac is emissive in pure THF, weakens sharply on initial water addition, and recovers stronger emission at high water fractions. The target's own panels were visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No cross-compound intensity comparison is made because axes and baseline intensities differ. No digitized enhancement factor or absolute quantum yield is inferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The formation of aggregates could effectively block molecular motions and inhibit the
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three Cz-Sac emitters including DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF/water aggregates at high water fractions, section 3.6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors explicitly propose that aggregation blocks molecular motion, including carbazole rotation, and suppresses nonradiative decay to produce AIEE.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is an interpretation of aggregation-dependent spectra, not measured rotational barriers or conical-intersection calculations.

reference_evidence_units.quote: dark twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT) states formed with the increase of solvent polarity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Three Cz-Sac emitters including DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Initial water addition versus aggregation at water fraction greater than 80%.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign initial quenching to dark TICT states and subsequent intensity recovery/blue shift to aggregation suppressing motion and reducing solvent relaxation/TICT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Mixed-solvent polarity and aggregation change together; TICT is an explicit but not uniquely proven assignment. Do not equate this with intermolecular PET.

reference_evidence_units.quote: DiCz-Sac also shows a distinctive double-exponential decay in the neat film with a delayed lifetime of 3.2 μs
reference_evidence_units.subject: DiCz-Sac
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Neat film temperature-dependent transient PL, Fig.4E-F; inert/oxygen solution control reported with Fig.S19.
reference_evidence_units.statement: DiCz-Sac exhibits a 3.2 microsecond delayed film component (prompt 18.3 ns shown in Fig.4E) that becomes more evident on warming; its delayed solution component is quenched by oxygen. The authors assign TADF, consistent with a spectroscopic S1-T1 gap of 0.20 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig.4E-F visually inspected; oxygen-control SI was not inspected. These film/solution data are distinct from the 285 ms crystal RTP and approximately 2.5 ms lab-carbazole control.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The explicit proposed AIEE mechanism is aggregation restricting internal motion, including carbazole rotation, and reducing nonradiative loss. Spectral recovery is observed; the microscopic attribution remains an author interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal interactions are explicitly proposed to stabilize triplets and constrain loss. The independent purity control prevents attributing ultralong lifetimes solely to packing.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Keep the source's ICT solvatochromism and dark-TICT quenching interpretation with the solvent/aggregation confound stated.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: RTP is supported in crystals and TADF is supported in film/solution, with phase-specific lifetimes and impurity dependence distinguished.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The explicit proposed AIEE mechanism is aggregation restricting internal motion, including carbazole rotation, and reducing nonradiative loss. Spectral recovery is observed; the microscopic attribution remains an author interpretation.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Crystal interactions are explicitly proposed to stabilize triplets and constrain loss. The independent purity control prevents attributing ultralong lifetimes solely to packing.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Trace-isomer dependence is acknowledged, but no direct host binding, inclusion or identified host-guest photophysical pathway is established in the inspected main text.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Keep the source's ICT solvatochromism and dark-TICT quenching interpretation with the solvent/aggregation confound stated.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is reported in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established; orbital transitions alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation or close contacts do not by themselves establish an aggregate exciton, excimer, exciplex, or H/J excited state.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The selected evidence does not isolate a distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance explanation beyond the other explicitly assigned pathways.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: RTP is supported in crystals and TADF is supported in film/solution, with phase-specific lifetimes and impurity dependence distinguished.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated decay or restriction of access is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state or anti-Kasha emission assignment is established for this target in the selected evidence.
